merge_rivers

Source: R/merge_rivers.R
merge_rivers.Rd

Merges river lines

Usage

merge_rivers(path_to_ras_dbase, is_verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

path_to_ras_dbase

The path to the folder in which you are building your catalog, Default: NULL

is_verbose

flag to determine whether print statements are shown - TRUE to show messages - FALSE to skip non-critical ones, Default: TRUE

Value

Merged HEC-RAS flowpath conceptual equivalents
